concept.hr: Multipleksiranje i zastoj na čelu reda: TCP naspram QUIC-a
concept.en: Multiplexing, and head-of-line blocking at TCP vs QUIC

summary.hr: Ista stranica preko tri inačice HTTP-a na jednoj vremenskoj crti: veze i rukovanja, tokovi na jednoj vezi i što zaustavi jedan izgubljeni segment.
summary.en: The same page over three HTTP versions on one timeline: connections and handshakes, streams on one connection, and what one lost segment holds up.

concept.hr: Zahtjevi zaredom na jednoj vezi: 800 ms; HTTP/2 ih multipleksira: 300 ms
concept.en: Requests in a row on one connection: 800 ms; HTTP/2 multiplexes them: 300 ms

concept.hr: Jedan gubitak zaustavi sve HTTP/2 tokove; u HTTP/3 čeka samo njegov tok
concept.en: One loss stalls every HTTP/2 stream; in HTTP/3 only its own stream waits
